# Support

> Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SUPPORT.vi.md)

This is an open-source engineering/reproducibility project and does not provide a commercial support SLA.

## Where to ask

- Use the bug-report template for reproducible defects.
- Use the feature-request template for scoped improvements.
- Use the question template for setup or usage questions.
- Use the security process in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for vulnerabilities.

## What to include

For technical help, provide the repository commit SHA or release tag, Python/PyTorch versions, environment, selected execution profile, accelerator topology, model source or mount path, first failed gate, and a minimal sanitized log excerpt.

For GPU claims, state whether the session actually used one T4 or T4x2. CPU-only output cannot establish live GPU behavior.
